description: NaCr(SO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are two shorter (2.59 Å) and four longer (2.66 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.99 Å) and four longer (2.02 Å) Cr-O bond lengths. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-46°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.51 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cr and one S atom.
